claims.text: Analgesics and cold or warm compresses for Sx relief
claims.quote: Analgesic medications and cold or warm compresses can provide symptomatic relief for parotid swelling and associated discomfort.

claims.text: Isolate 5 days after parotid swelling begins
claims.quote: Individuals with suspected or confirmed mumps should follow droplet precautions and remain isolated for 5 days after the onset of parotid swelling to minimize the risk of transmission to others, including by staying home from school or work.
